exact_missing_items: current: projection up to date for normal read + write interaction
refreshing: slightly behind but actively catching up; read fine, write may be fine depending on object class
stale: data old enough that mutation-bearing actions should narrow or require refetch
degraded: projector or dependency failure; surface may be incomplete or partially wrong
unavailable: projection cannot support that surface; UI must fall back or disable
exports derived from stale/degraded projections must either: disclose trust state in the export/manifest, or re-query from canonical/current backing data before export

Promotion model must be: explicit runtime state transitions, automation-first, with optional HITL that may pause but not replace automation; blocked promotions must surface on Dashboard/Orchestrator/chat
Orchestrator page ownership boundary: allowed = page layout/controls, view-model/projections, run control intents; NOT ALLOWED = canonical runtime enums, event semantics, scheduler truth
gap_candidates.blocking_reason: Coverage row indicates incomplete or missing canon alignment for concrete target.
